entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... um... I'm just so confused. I bought these... uh... cycling shoes? And I don't think they're right for me. I think I need to send them back.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Alex Garcia, order number 788-1254. I'm just... I'm not sure what I'm doing wrong. The website was a bit overwhelming and I feel a little lost.

Thank you, Alex. I have your order right here for the Road Cycling Shoes. I understand it can be a lot of information. Just so I can best assist you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?

Oh, I don't know if it's a fault. Maybe? My feet just hurt so much after one ride. I think I'm getting blisters. And the things on the bottom... the cleats? I couldn't figure them out at all. It's just too much. Can't you just help me? I really just want a refund.

I'm very sorry to hear the shoes are causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. It sounds like a fit and comfort issue. Let me just take a quick look at our return policy for your order.
Okay... I just hope it's not too complicated. I'm not very good with these things.

Not at all. I see here that your cycling shoes were delivered just 6 days ago. Our policy allows for returns on items like these for up to 90 days from the delivery date. You are well within that window, so we can absolutely process this for you.
Oh! Really? That's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with them. So I can get a full refund?

Yes, that's correct. A full refund to your original payment method. I've just initiated the return process in our system. I'm sending an email to you right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions on how to send the shoes back to us.
Wow, thank you so much, Sarah. You've made this so easy. I was really stressed about it.
You're very welcome, Alex. We're happy to help. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
Alright. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
